Sau n\u0103m 1975, \u0111\u1ee9ng tr\u01b0\u1edbc nhu c\u1ea7u c\u1ea5p b&aacute;ch v\u1ec1 x&acirc;y d\u1ef1ng v&agrave; ph&aacute;t tri\u1ec3n ng&agrave;nh c\u01a1 kh&iacute; giao th&ocirc;ng ph&iacute;a Nam, tr&ecirc;n c\u01a1 s\u1edf h&atilde;ng th\u1ea7u RMK ti\u1ebfp qu\u1ea3n sau gi\u1ea3i ph&oacute;ng, Nh&agrave; n\u01b0\u1edbc v&agrave; B\u1ed9 Giao th&ocirc;ng v\u1eadn t\u1ea3i \u0111&atilde; th&agrave;nh l\u1eadp Nh&agrave; m&aacute;y C\u01a1 kh&iacute; C&ocirc;ng tr&igrave;nh v\u1edbi ch\u1ee9c n\u0103ng s\u1eeda ch\u1eefa l\u1eafp r&aacute;p xe m&aacute;y c&ocirc;ng tr&igrave;nh, &ocirc;t&ocirc; c&aacute;c lo\u1ea1i, \u0111&oacute;ng v&agrave; s\u1eeda ch\u1eefa t&agrave;u th\u1ee7y...<\/p>\r\n\r\n<p>T\u1eeb \u0111&oacute; t\u1edbi nay C&ocirc;ng ty \u0111&atilde; nhi\u1ec1u l\u1ea7n \u0111\u1ed5i t&ecirc;n v&agrave; t&aacute;ch ra th&agrave;nh l\u1eadp c&aacute;c doanh nghi\u1ec7p m\u1edbi. \u0110\u1ebfn n\u0103m 1996 C&ocirc;ng ty C\u01a1 kh&iacute; Giao th&ocirc;ng 2 \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c th&agrave;nh l\u1eadp l\u1ea1i th&agrave;nh C&ocirc;ng ty c&oacute; H\u1ed9i \u0111\u1ed3ng qu\u1ea3n tr\u1ecb. Th\u1ef1c hi\u1ec7n ch\u1ee7 tr\u01b0\u01a1ng c\u1ed5 ph\u1ea7n ho&aacute; c&aacute;c doanh nghi\u1ec7p Nh&agrave; n\u01b0\u1edbc c\u1ee7a Ch&iacute;nh ph\u1ee7, th&aacute;ng 9\/2003 C&ocirc;ng ty ti\u1ebfn h&agrave;nh c\u1ed5 ph\u1ea7n ho&aacute; th&agrave;nh l\u1eadp C&ocirc;ng ty C\u1ed5 ph\u1ea7n C\u01a1 kh&iacute; - X&acirc;y d\u1ef1ng giao th&ocirc;ng (Tracomeco).<\/p>","noidung_en":"<div style=\"width: 1200px;max-width: 100%;\">\r\n<div class=\"showText_half\" style=\"width: calc(50% - 20px); margin: 10px; float: left; text-align: justify;\">\r\n<p><strong>C&ocirc;ng Ty C\u1ed5 Ph\u1ea7n C\u01a1 Kh&iacute; - X&acirc;y D\u1ef1ng Giao Th&ocirc;ng (Tracomeco)<\/strong>&nbsp;\u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c th&agrave;nh l\u1eadp l\u1ea1i theo Quy\u1ebft \u0111\u1ecbnh s\u1ed1 2863\/Q\u0110 - BGTVT c\u1ee7a B\u1ed9 Giao Th&ocirc;ng V\u1eadn T\u1ea3i k&yacute; ng&agrave;y 10\/9\/2002 v\u1ec1 vi\u1ec7c chuy\u1ec3n Doanh nghi\u1ec7p Nh&agrave; n\u01b0\u1edbc th&agrave;nh C&ocirc;ng ty C\u1ed5 ph\u1ea7n.<\/p>\r\n\r\n<p>Ti\u1ec1n th&acirc;n c\u1ee7a C&ocirc;ng ty l&agrave;&nbsp;<strong>H&atilde;ng th\u1ea7u RMK<\/strong>&nbsp;do M\u1ef9 th&agrave;nh l\u1eadp t\u1eeb n\u0103m 1962 v&agrave; l&agrave; m\u1ed9t c\u01a1 s\u1edf \u0111\u1ea1i tu xe m&aacute;y thi c&ocirc;ng c&ocirc;ng tr&igrave;nh v&agrave; s\u1ea3n xu\u1ea5t k\u1ebft c\u1ea5u th&eacute;p l\u1edbn nh\u1ea5t \u0110&ocirc;ng Nam &Aacute; th\u1eddi b\u1ea5y gi\u1edd. Sau n\u0103m 1975, \u0111\u1ee9ng tr\u01b0\u1edbc nhu c\u1ea7u c\u1ea5p b&aacute;ch v\u1ec1 x&acirc;y d\u1ef1ng v&agrave; ph&aacute;t tri\u1ec3n ng&agrave;nh c\u01a1 kh&iacute; giao th&ocirc;ng ph&iacute;a Nam, tr&ecirc;n c\u01a1 s\u1edf h&atilde;ng th\u1ea7u RMK ti\u1ebfp qu\u1ea3n sau gi\u1ea3i ph&oacute;ng, Nh&agrave; n\u01b0\u1edbc v&agrave; B\u1ed9 Giao th&ocirc;ng v\u1eadn t\u1ea3i \u0111&atilde; th&agrave;nh l\u1eadp Nh&agrave; m&aacute;y C\u01a1 kh&iacute; C&ocirc;ng tr&igrave;nh v\u1edbi ch\u1ee9c n\u0103ng s\u1eeda ch\u1eefa l\u1eafp r&aacute;p xe m&aacute;y c&ocirc;ng tr&igrave;nh, &ocirc;t&ocirc; c&aacute;c lo\u1ea1i, \u0111&oacute;ng v&agrave; s\u1eeda ch\u1eefa t&agrave;u th\u1ee7y...<\/p>\r\n\r\n<p>T\u1eeb \u0111&oacute; t\u1edbi nay C&ocirc;ng ty \u0111&atilde; nhi\u1ec1u l\u1ea7n \u0111\u1ed5i t&ecirc;n v&agrave; t&aacute;ch ra th&agrave;nh l\u1eadp c&aacute;c doanh nghi\u1ec7p m\u1edbi. \u0110\u1ebfn n\u0103m 1996 C&ocirc;ng ty C\u01a1 kh&iacute; Giao th&ocirc;ng 2 \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c th&agrave;nh l\u1eadp l\u1ea1i th&agrave;nh C&ocirc;ng ty c&oacute; H\u1ed9i \u0111\u1ed3ng qu\u1ea3n tr\u1ecb.
